content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-97 (bundled/not separately payable), which is a coding/edit issue rather than medical necessity — the prior medical-necessity appeal was the wrong tool and left CO-97 standing. The correct remedy is to fix the claim (e.g., add an appropriate distinct-service modifier) and resubmit; since the claim was denied, not paid, this is not a prohibited CO-18 duplicate. Timely filing still has 88 days, so a corrected resubmission is viable.","action":"correct_and_resubmit"}
